prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1419; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full address for the record.

A: I live in Katy, Texas, on a residential street near the high school.

Q: Walk me through what happened when you approached the intersection.

A: I was heading through on a green light. I slowed down a little because traffic was heavy, and then a silver sedan came from the left side and pulled into my lane. I hit the brakes but there wasn't enough room.

Q: Did the other vehicle have a signal or stop sign?

A: I didn't see a signal for them. I think they were turning, but I'm not totally sure.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were going?

A: Maybe around thirty miles an hour, maybe a bit less because of the traffic.

Q: Where did your vehicle make contact with the other car?

A: On my driver's side, the front door area. The impact pushed my car sideways.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back hurts when I sit or stand for a long time. I went to urgent care the same day.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: I'm going to physical therapy twice a week, and my doctor prescribed muscle relaxers and some anti-inflammatories.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some minor stiffness years ago but nothing that needed treatment.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm still getting used to the pain and I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
